_comment: sdk/describe.js: what well-known programs are, in English (docs/MONITOR.md, Descriptions). kernel: a kernel thread's name, exact or (ending in / or _ or -) a prefix; programs: an executable's file name, for a program in a system folder only. lordos: every LordOS program (tools/desc-check.mjs fails when one built or shipped is missing).

kernel.kthreadd: The kernel's thread that starts all its other threads.
kernel.kworker/: A kernel worker thread: runs short jobs the kernel queues (disk, network, power and driver work).
kernel.ksoftirqd/: A kernel thread that finishes interrupt work (network packets, timers) on one processor when there is a lot of it.
kernel.migration/: A kernel thread that moves tasks between processors to balance the load.
kernel.rcu_: A kernel thread of RCU, the mechanism that frees memory safely while other processors may still read it.
kernel.rcuog/: A kernel thread of RCU, the mechanism that frees memory safely while other processors may still read it.
kernel.rcuop/: A kernel thread of RCU, the mechanism that frees memory safely while other processors may still read it.
kernel.rcuos/: A kernel thread of RCU, the mechanism that frees memory safely while other processors may still read it.
kernel.cpuhp/: A kernel thread that brings a processor online or offline.
kernel.idle_inject/: A kernel thread that forces short idle periods on a processor to keep it cool.
kernel.kswapd: The kernel's memory reclaimer: frees memory by writing unused pages to swap or dropping cached files.
kernel.khugepaged: A kernel thread that joins small memory pages into large ones so programs run faster.
kernel.kcompactd: A kernel thread that moves memory around to make large free blocks.
kernel.oom_reaper: A kernel thread that frees the memory of a program ended because the computer ran out of memory.
kernel.writeback: Kernel work that writes changed files from memory to disk.
kernel.kblockd: Kernel work for the disks' request queues.
kernel.kintegrityd: Kernel work that checks data integrity on disks that support it.
kernel.blkcg_punt_bio: Kernel work that hands disk requests to the right control group.
kernel.ksmd: The kernel's same-page merging: shares identical memory pages between programs (virtual machines).
kernel.kdevtmpfs: A kernel thread that creates the device files in /dev.
kernel.kauditd: A kernel thread that sends audit records to the audit service.
kernel.khungtaskd: A kernel thread that reports tasks stuck for a long time.
kernel.watchdogd: The kernel's watchdog thread: notices when the system stops responding.
kernel.watchdog/: The kernel's watchdog thread: notices when a processor stops responding.
kernel.irq/: A kernel thread that handles one device's interrupts.
kernel.jbd2/: A kernel thread that writes the ext4 file system's journal, which keeps files consistent after a crash.
kernel.ext4-rsv-conver: Kernel work of the ext4 file system that finishes writes to space reserved in advance.
kernel.scsi_eh_: A kernel thread that recovers a disk controller from errors.
kernel.scsi_tmf_: Kernel work that manages a disk controller's tasks.
kernel.nvme-: Kernel work of the NVMe disk driver.
kernel.kthrotld: Kernel work that limits a control group's disk speed.
kernel.edac-poller: Kernel work that checks the memory for hardware errors.
kernel.devfreq_wq: Kernel work that changes a device's speed to save power.
kernel.card: A kernel thread of the graphics driver (one display's updates).
kernel.ttm: Kernel work of the graphics drivers' memory manager.
kernel.amdgpu: A kernel thread of the AMD graphics driver.
kernel.i915: A kernel thread of the Intel graphics driver.
kernel.nouveau: A kernel thread of the open NVIDIA graphics driver.
kernel.nvidia: A kernel thread of the NVIDIA graphics driver.
kernel.ipv6_addrconf: Kernel work that sets up IPv6 addresses.
kernel.mm_percpu_wq: Kernel work for each processor's memory statistics.
kernel.netns: Kernel work that cleans up network namespaces.
kernel.kstrp: Kernel work of the stream parser (network).
kernel.zswap-shrink: Kernel work that shrinks the compressed swap cache.
kernel.krfcommd: A kernel thread of Bluetooth's RFCOMM (serial over Bluetooth).
kernel.cfg80211: Kernel work of the Wi-Fi configuration layer.
kernel.iwlwifi: Kernel work of the Intel Wi-Fi driver.
kernel.btrfs-: Kernel work of the Btrfs file system.
kernel.xfs: Kernel work of the XFS file system.
kernel.kcryptd: Kernel work that encrypts and decrypts an encrypted disk.
kernel.dm_bufio_cache: Kernel work of the device mapper's buffer cache.
kernel.kverityd: Kernel work that checks a verified read-only disk.
kernel.loop: A kernel thread of a loop device (a file used as a disk).
kernel.psimon: A kernel thread that measures pressure on the processor, memory and disks.
kernel.pool_workqueue_release: Kernel work that releases unused worker pools.
kernel.inet_frag_wq: Kernel work that reassembles fragmented network packets.
kernel.tpm_dev_wq: Kernel work of the TPM security chip.
kernel.ata_sff: Kernel work of the ATA (SATA) disk driver.
kernel.usb-storage: A kernel thread of a USB disk or memory stick.
kernel.hwrng: A kernel thread that feeds the hardware random number generator into the kernel.
kernel.kipmi: A kernel thread of the server management controller (IPMI).
kernel.acpi_thermal_pm: Kernel work of the ACPI thermal zones.
kernel.kacpid: Kernel work of ACPI, the power and device configuration interface.
kernel.kacpi_notify: Kernel work that handles ACPI notifications (lid, buttons, batteries).
kernel.khvcd: A kernel thread of the hypervisor console.
kernel.vfio-irqfd-clea: Kernel work of VFIO, which gives a virtual machine a device.
kernel.kvm: Kernel work of KVM, the kernel's virtual machine support.
kernel.slub_flushwq: Kernel work that flushes the memory allocator's per-processor caches.
kernel.events_: Kernel work of the shared work queues.
kernel.sugov:: A kernel thread that changes a processor's speed (schedutil governor).
kernel.ecryptfs-kthread: A kernel thread of the eCryptfs encrypted file system.
kernel.napi/: A kernel thread that receives network packets for one network card.
kernel.spi: A kernel thread of an SPI bus (small devices on the board).
kernel.zram: Kernel work of zram, compressed memory used as swap.
kernel.erofs_: Kernel work of the EROFS read-only file system.
kernel.kunit_: A kernel thread of the kernel's self-tests.

programs.systemd: systemd, the system and service manager: starts the system's services and the session's background programs.
programs.(sd-pam): A helper of systemd that closes the session's login modules when the session ends.
programs.systemd-journald: The system log: collects the messages of the system and its services.
programs.systemd-logind: Manages logins, sessions, seats and power keys (sleep, power off).
programs.systemd-udevd: Sets up devices as they are plugged in (names, permissions, drivers).
programs.systemd-resolved: Resolves names to addresses (DNS) for the system.
programs.systemd-timesyncd: Keeps the clock right by asking time servers on the network.
programs.systemd-oomd: Ends programs before the computer runs out of memory.
programs.systemd-userdbd: Answers questions about users and groups.
programs.systemd-homed: Manages home folders that move between computers.
programs.systemd-machined: Keeps track of running virtual machines and containers.
programs.systemd-localed: Changes the system's language and keyboard settings.
programs.systemd-timedated: Changes the system's clock and time zone.
programs.systemd-journal-remote: Receives log messages from other computers.
programs.init: The first program of the system: starts everything else.
programs.dbus-daemon: D-Bus, the message bus programs use to talk to each other and to the system.
programs.dbus-broker: D-Bus, the message bus programs use to talk to each other and to the system.
programs.dbus-broker-launch: Starts D-Bus, the message bus programs use to talk to each other.
programs.pipewire: PipeWire, the sound and video server: carries audio between apps, speakers, microphones and cameras.
programs.pipewire-pulse: PipeWire's PulseAudio service: lets apps made for PulseAudio play and record through PipeWire.
programs.wireplumber: WirePlumber, PipeWire's session manager: chooses the speakers, microphones and cameras and connects apps to them.
programs.xdg-desktop-portal: Desktop portal: lets sandboxed apps (Flatpak) open files, take screenshots or print with the person's permission.
programs.xdg-document-portal: Desktop portal: gives sandboxed apps only the files the person chose.
programs.xdg-permission-store: Desktop portal: remembers the permissions given to sandboxed apps.
programs.xdg-desktop-portal-gtk: Desktop portal's GTK dialogs (file chooser) for sandboxed apps.
programs.xdg-desktop-portal-gnome: Desktop portal's GNOME dialogs for sandboxed apps.
programs.xdg-desktop-portal-wlr: Desktop portal's screen sharing for sandboxed apps.
programs.xdg-desktop-portal-lordos: LordOS's desktop portal: screen sharing and file dialogs for sandboxed apps.
programs.gvfsd: GVfs: lets apps open network and removable locations.
programs.gvfsd-fuse: GVfs: shows network and removable locations as folders.
programs.gvfsd-metadata: GVfs: stores extra information about files.
programs.gvfs-udisks2-volume-monitor: GVfs: watches disks and memory sticks being plugged in.
programs.at-spi-bus-launcher: Starts the accessibility bus that screen readers use.
programs.at-spi2-registryd: The accessibility registry screen readers use to read apps.
programs.polkitd: polkit: decides which programs may do administrator actions, and asks for a password when needed.
programs.udisksd: UDisks: mounts disks and memory sticks for the person.
programs.upowerd: UPower: reports batteries and power supplies.
programs.wpa_supplicant: Connects to Wi-Fi networks and handles their passwords and encryption.
programs.iwd: iNet wireless daemon: connects to Wi-Fi networks.
programs.bluetoothd: BlueZ, the Bluetooth service: finds and connects Bluetooth devices.
programs.cups-browsed: Finds printers shared on the network.
programs.avahi-daemon: Avahi: finds printers, shared folders and other services on the local network (mDNS).
programs.cron: Runs scheduled tasks at set times.
programs.crond: Runs scheduled tasks at set times.
programs.atd: Runs tasks scheduled once with the at command.
programs.rsyslogd: A system log service: writes the system's messages to files.
programs.sshd: OpenSSH server: lets other computers log in to this one over the network.
programs.sshd-session: One OpenSSH login session from another computer.
programs.ssh: OpenSSH client: a secure connection to another computer.
programs.ssh-agent: Keeps SSH keys unlocked during the session so connections don't ask again.
programs.gpg-agent: Keeps GnuPG keys unlocked for signing and decrypting.
programs.dirmngr: GnuPG's network helper: fetches keys and revocation lists.
programs.agetty: Shows the text login prompt on a console.
programs.login: Logs a person in on a text console.
programs.sudo: Runs a command as another user (usually the administrator).
programs.accounts-daemon: Gives information about the computer's user accounts.
programs.rtkit-daemon: RealtimeKit: gives sound programs real-time priority so audio doesn't stutter.
programs.colord: Manages color profiles of screens and printers.
programs.packagekitd: PackageKit: installs and updates software for other programs.
programs.chronyd: Keeps the clock right by asking time servers on the network.
programs.ntpd: Keeps the clock right by asking time servers on the network.
programs.irqbalance: Spreads hardware interrupts across the processors.
programs.smartd: Watches disks' health (SMART) and warns before they fail.
programs.multipathd: Manages disks reachable through several paths.
programs.containerd-shim-runc-v2: Keeps one container running for containerd.
programs.dockerd: Docker's service: builds and runs containers.
programs.docker-proxy: Forwards a network port to a Docker container.
programs.qemu-system-x86_64: QEMU: runs a virtual machine (an x86-64 computer).
programs.qemu-system-aarch64: QEMU: runs a virtual machine (an ARM 64-bit computer).
programs.passt: passt: gives a virtual machine its network without administrator rights.
programs.pasta: pasta: gives a container its network without administrator rights.
programs.virtiofsd: Shares a folder with a virtual machine.
programs.swtpm: A software TPM security chip for a virtual machine.
programs.Xwayland: Xwayland: runs older X11 apps on the Wayland desktop.
programs.flatpak-portal: Flatpak's portal: lets a sandboxed app start sandboxed helpers.
programs.flatpak-session-helper: Flatpak's session helper: gives sandboxed apps the session's settings.
programs.flatpak-system-helper: Flatpak's system helper: installs apps for every user.
programs.bwrap: bubblewrap: the sandbox that keeps a Flatpak or other app apart from the rest of the system.
programs.gnome-keyring-daemon: Keeps passwords and keys for apps, unlocked with the login.
programs.ibus-daemon: IBus: input methods for writing in languages like Chinese, Japanese or Korean.
programs.fcitx5: Fcitx 5: input methods for writing in languages like Chinese, Japanese or Korean.
programs.tor: Tor: sends connections through the Tor network for anonymity.
programs.llama-server: llama.cpp's server: runs Sentinela's local language model, offline, in its sandbox.
programs.bash: Bash, the command shell: runs the commands typed in a terminal or written in a script.
programs.sh: The system's command shell (sh): runs commands and scripts.
programs.dash: Dash, a small fast command shell (/bin/sh): runs scripts.
programs.tmux: tmux: keeps terminal sessions running and splits a terminal into panes.
programs.screen: GNU Screen: keeps terminal sessions running.
programs.sleep: Waits for a given time (used by scripts).
programs.make: GNU Make: builds software from its source code following a Makefile.
programs.cc1: The C compiler's main part (GCC): turns C source code into machine code.
programs.cc1plus: The C++ compiler's main part (GCC): turns C++ source code into machine code.
programs.ld: The linker: joins compiled code into a program.
programs.as: The assembler: turns assembly code into machine code.
programs.git: Git: tracks changes to source code and other files.
programs.node: Node.js: runs JavaScript programs outside a browser.
programs.python3: Python 3: runs programs written in Python.
programs.perl: Perl: runs programs written in Perl.
programs.ruby: Ruby: runs programs written in Ruby.
programs.java: Java: runs programs written for the Java platform.
programs.rg: ripgrep: searches text in files quickly.
programs.less: Shows a text a screen at a time.
programs.vim: Vim, a text editor for the terminal.
programs.nano: nano, a simple text editor for the terminal.
programs.htop: htop: an interactive list of running programs.
programs.top: top: a live list of running programs.
programs.rclone: rclone: copies and syncs files with cloud storage.
programs.dpkg: dpkg: installs and removes Debian packages.
programs.apt: APT: installs and updates Debian packages.
programs.chrome: Google Chrome, a web browser (one of its processes).
programs.chromium: Chromium, a web browser (one of its processes).
programs.WebKitWebProcess: WebKit's page process: draws and runs one web page in its sandbox.
programs.WebKitNetworkProcess: WebKit's network process: downloads web pages for a WebKit app.
programs.code: Visual Studio Code, a code editor (one of its processes).
programs.claude: Claude Code, an AI coding assistant for the terminal.
programs.obs: OBS Studio: records and streams video.
programs.ffmpeg: FFmpeg: converts and records audio and video.
programs.steam: Steam, a game store and launcher.
programs.snapd: snapd: installs and runs snap packages.
programs.power-profiles-daemon: Switches between power-saving and performance profiles.
programs.tuned: Tunes the system for a workload or power use.
programs.auditd: The audit service: records security-relevant events.
programs.apparmor: AppArmor, which limits what programs may do.
programs.openvpn: OpenVPN: a virtual private network (VPN) connection.
programs.wg-quick: WireGuard: sets up a VPN connection.
programs.dhclient: Asks the network for an address (DHCP).
programs.dnsmasq: dnsmasq: a small DNS and DHCP server.
programs.speech-dispatcher: Speech Dispatcher: reads text aloud for apps.
programs.geoclue: Tells apps where the computer is, with permission.

lordos.lord-server: LordOS's display server and desktop: draws the screen, runs the desktop and its apps, and keeps each app in its place.
lordos.lord-sessiond: LordOS's session manager (administrator): starts the login screen and the sessions, and lends them the screen and the input devices.
lordos.lord-netd: LordOS's network service (administrator): connects Wi-Fi, cable and VPNs when the person asks in Settings.
lordos.lord-netperm: LordOS's firewall service (administrator): enforces which apps may use the network.
lordos.lord-fand: LordOS's fan service (administrator): runs the fan curves chosen in Settings → Cooling.
lordos.lord-media: LordOS's media helper, in a sandbox: decodes music, video and pictures for the apps.
lordos.lord-doc: LordOS's document helper, in a sandbox: reads PDFs, archives and office documents for the apps.
lordos.lord-vault: LordOS's Passwords helper: keeps the password vault encrypted.
lordos.lord-maild: LordOS's Mail helper, in a sandbox: talks to the mail servers.
lordos.lord-fetch: LordOS's download helper, in a sandbox: fetches the weather, the Store's catalogs and other public data.
lordos.lord-tls: LordOS's secure connection helper, in a sandbox: encrypts the connections of other helpers.
lordos.lord-bench: LordOS's benchmark: measures this computer's speed.
lordos.lord-pgpv: LordOS's signature checker, in a sandbox: verifies the signatures of downloaded images.
lordos.lord-themec: LordOS's theme builder, in a sandbox: checks a community desktop style's files and builds it.
lordos.lord-appstream: LordOS's software catalog reader, in a sandbox: reads the Store's app catalogs.
lordos.lord-autoinstall: LordOS's unattended installer: installs LordOS on a disk without questions.
lordos.lord-browser-prefs: LordOS's browser setup: writes the first preferences of installed web browsers.
lordos.lord-claude-status: The Terminal's status line for Claude Code: shows its usage in the Terminal's footer.
lordos.lord-clean: Cleaner's helper, in a sandbox: finds large and duplicate files to clean.
lordos.lord-hidpp: LordOS's Logitech helper: reads the battery of Logitech mice and keyboards.
lordos.lord-lan: LordOS's local network helper, in a sandbox: finds and opens shared folders on the network.
lordos.lord-llm: Sentinela's engine launcher: starts the local language model in its sandbox, offline.
lordos.lord-ocr: LordOS's text recognition helper, in a sandbox: reads the text in pictures and scanned documents.
lordos.lord-pkexec: LordOS's pkexec: asks for the administrator's password in a LordOS dialog when an app needs it.
lordos.lord-rdesk: LordOS's remote desktop helper, in a sandbox: connects to another computer's screen.
lordos.lord-say: LordOS's voice: reads text aloud with the voice chosen in Settings.
lordos.lord-screencast: LordOS's screen recorder: records the screen to a video file.
lordos.lord-sftp: The Terminal's file transfer helper, in a sandbox: copies files over an SSH connection.
lordos.lord-sql: Databases' helper, in a sandbox: talks to the database servers.
lordos.lord-stream: LordOS's streaming helper, in a sandbox: plays internet radio and video streams.
lordos.lord-studio: LordOS Studio's camera helper: blurs or replaces the background and improves the camera's picture.
lordos.lord-spell: LordOS's spell checker, in a sandbox: checks words against the installed dictionaries and suggests corrections.
lordos.lord-nvgpu: Monitor's NVIDIA reader, in a sandbox: reads an NVIDIA card's load, memory and temperature while the GPU view is open.
lordos.lord-tts: LordOS's speech helper, in a sandbox: turns text into speech.
lordos.lord-vm: Machines' runner: starts and watches one virtual machine in its sandbox.
lordos.lord-vmdisplay: Machines' display helper, in a sandbox: shows a virtual machine's screen.
lordos.lord-vm-usb: Machines' USB library hint, loaded into a virtual machine's emulator: only lets it use the USB devices it is given.
lordos.lord-vmunpack: Machines' image unpacker, in a sandbox: unpacks a downloaded machine image.
lordos.lord-web: LordOS's web app runner: opens a web app in its own window and sandbox.
lordos.lord-server-test: LordOS's test version of the display server, for development.
